output.summary: An aquatic fern native across parts of Europe and Asia, from central and southern Europe to Vietnam. Its four-part leaves resemble four-leaf clover and may float in deep water or stand upright in shallow water or on land. In mainland Portugal it underwent severe decline during the last century and was assessed as Critically Endangered.
output.edibilityNote: The plant has reportedly been used as food in some places for more than 3,000 years.
